objective_contribution: Test whether tokenizer-fitted exact-generation process state helps GLM-5.3-flash resume useful reasoning after actual local recycling at 8K and improves native ContextBench evidence selection within the same cumulative model input plus output token cap.

question_and_hypotheses.question: After actual local recycling, does tokenizer-fitted exact-generation state improve native evidence selection without projection-size failures within the same cumulative model-token cap?

measurement_mapping.native: Paired ContextBench span and file metrics measure source-evidence selection; they do not establish repair correctness or semantic retention by themselves.
measurement_mapping.retention: Successful post-recycle model requests bound to tokenizer-fitted state establish exposure; useful retention additionally requires improved native outcomes or completed correctness evidence.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Every projected fact binds to task input, successful request receipt, tool event, or repository result; evictions are counted and newest facts are retained deterministically.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count every model input and output token, including fitted state presentation, recovery, failed submissions, and corrections. Tokenizer-only fitting calls are evidence but are outside the selected model-token optimization cost.
measurement_mapping.transfer: One exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K development round cannot establish another window, model, domain, full-cohort result, semantic retention, or repair correctness.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: GLM small-window chapter first; 8K development before 10K/12K and reserved confirmation.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Rounds one through seven and the eight round-four development identities are exposed. Reserved confirmation remains untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: No within-round tuning, replacement, source refresh, threshold changes, or lucky reruns. Pause unstarted cells on shared provider or instrument failure and retain every attempt.

retained_counterevidence: Round four source-index recovery produced negligible span gain, file regression, and 77,656 extra model tokens.
Round five repaired terminal validity without establishing useful state, semantic retention, or repair correctness.
Round six used 21,019 known model tokens but produced zero state exposure because of speculative measurement.

Round seven achieved four exact-generation presentations with zero speculation, then a 1,224-token state exceeded its 1,024-token cap and degraded treatment completion; 99,018 model tokens were consumed across the pair.
Even correctly fitted state may distract the model, omit necessary older facts, or fail to improve semantic evidence selection.
successor_rule: Freeze H14 only after bounded fitting controls, exact round-seven overflow replay, matched design, preflight, source closure, D07/D08 binding and freeze continuity pass. Run each frozen cell once. Passing exposed development evidence may prepare untouched confirmation under the unchanged acceptance contract; failure or inconclusive evidence must retain all outcomes and select a reviewed successor. Never rerun unchanged, lower thresholds, infer clearance, or transition automatically to another benchmark.

criterion_verdicts.enduring_objective: H14 tests reusable reasoning continuity, recovery, correctness-oriented completion and outcomes under total model-token cost.
criterion_verdicts.initial_GLM_objective: H14 directly tests GLM-5.3-flash after recycling at 8K; later small windows remain ordered after valid 8K evidence.
criterion_verdicts.current_milestone: The fixed ContextBench acceptance contract remains the uncleared milestone; development evidence cannot clear it.
criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: The reviewed round-seven exposed cap failure leads through an explicit gap, question, H14/H15/H0 selection, fixed experiment and future observation/decision chain.
criterion_verdicts.counterevidence: Weak prior quality, added tokens, terminal-only validity, zero-exposure failure, and exposed token-cap completion failure all constrain H14.
criterion_verdicts.measurement_and_token_cost: Native selection, exact exposure, fit integrity, correctness limits and cumulative model input plus output tokens are separated.
criterion_verdicts.scope_and_acceptance: Only exposed 8K development tasks are used; SWE-bench is excluded and full identities, windows, tiers and reserved repetitions remain unchanged.
criterion_verdicts.testability: H14 has deterministic bounded fitting, exact replay, one changed arm variable, fixed thresholds, falsifiers and stopping rules.
